root.title: Skills directory
root.description: Directory containing skill folders with SKILL.md files. A leading ~/ uses the home directory; a missing directory loads an empty catalog.

max_file_bytes.title: Skill file limit (bytes)
max_file_bytes.description: Maximum size of one SKILL.md file. Must not exceed the total skill content limit.

max_total_bytes.title: Total skill content limit (bytes)
max_total_bytes.description: Maximum combined size of all loaded SKILL.md files.

max_catalog_bytes.title: Catalog size limit (bytes)
max_catalog_bytes.description: Maximum size of the serialized skill catalog returned by the provider.

catalog_contribution_id.title: Prompt contribution ID
catalog_contribution_id.description: Stable ID for the skill catalog prompt contribution. Start with a lowercase letter or digit; remaining characters may also include dots, underscores, slashes and hyphens.

max_prompt_catalog_bytes.title: Prompt catalog limit (bytes)
max_prompt_catalog_bytes.description: Maximum skill catalog text included in the prompt. Entries are shortened or omitted to fit.

max_resource_entries.title: Resource entry limit
max_resource_entries.description: Maximum non-hidden filesystem entries visited across all skill resources.

max_resource_file_bytes.title: Resource file limit (bytes)
max_resource_file_bytes.description: Maximum size of one resource file. Must not exceed the total resource content limit.

max_resource_total_bytes.title: Total resource content limit (bytes)
max_resource_total_bytes.description: Maximum combined resource file content loaded across all skills.

max_resource_manifest_bytes.title: Resource manifest limit (bytes)
max_resource_manifest_bytes.description: Maximum serialized resource manifest size for one skill.
